provenance: Written for the black-box cassette cases (2026-11-26): our own content, nothing taken from a ROM. Files of several data blocks: a BASIC program as text (LONG, three blocks), a BASIC program as text whose second line has no line number and which goes on for three blocks (NONUM), a data file of twenty-five records (BIGDATA, three blocks), then a short program (GOOD).
